incident_report.incident: Bumped near the 900 Metres.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Near the 100 Metres made contact with ALWAYS MY FOLKS when taken out by KING ALLOY.  Sent for sampling post-race.
R Kingscote pleaded guilty to a careless riding charge for causing interference near the 200 Metres (see SPICY SPANGLE).

Bumped with ROBOT KNIGHT shortly after the start due to both runners shifting ground.  Near the 900 Metres was bumped by ROBOT KNIGHT when that runner was taken out slightly by SPICY SPANGLE.  Near the 100 Metre was bumped.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
Jumped awkwardly.  Bumped with ALWAYS MY FOLKS shortly after the start due to both runners shifting ground.  Taken out slightly near the 900 Metres and was bumped.
Bumped at the start.  Momentarily crowded near the 800 Metres.  Had difficulty obtaining clear running between the 400 Metres and the 300 Metres when being shifted to the outside of ELEGANT LIFE.

Jumped only fairly.  R Kingscote (KING ALLOY) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 200 Metres he allowed his mount to shift in when not clear of SPICY SPANGLE, resulting in SPICY SPANGLE being crowded for room and having to be checked.  After assessing the carelessness grade 1 and the consequences grade 2 and having regard to his very good record, the Stewards determined the appropriate penalty to be a reprimand.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Bumped at the start.
Bumped on jumping.  Near the 900 Metres became unbalanced when bumped by SPORTIC WARRIOR.

When being shifted behind ELEGANT LIFE near the 900 Metres shifted in and was steadied to avoid that runner.  M L Yeung stated that he was given no specific instructions but when a number of runners to his inside showed good pace and he was concerned he would have not obtained cover he elected to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages to avoid covering additional ground.

Bumped on jumping.  Near the 900 Metres NEBRASKAN (D B McMonagle) shifted in when not quite clear, resulting in ISLAND BREEZES being taken in onto SPORTIC WARRIOR.  As a consequence SPORTIC WARRIOR then shifted in and away from ISLAND BREEZES and became unbalanced when it made contact with HAPPYDEARHAPPYDEER.  D B McMonagle was advised to ensure that he is two lengths clear when shifting ground.  Crowded near the 800 Metres.

Near the 900 Metres made contact with SPORTIC WARRIOR.  Approaching the 800 Metres was steadied when crowded between SPORTIC WARRIOR and MODEST GENTLEMAN which, after being taken in by ROBOT KNIGHT (K Teetan), then shifted in and away from that runner.  Whilst the Stewards acknowledged that K Teetan had corrected his mount, he was advised to exercise more care.  C L Chau stated that after settling back in the field as expected his mount found it difficult to make up ground in the Home Straight which he attributed to the rail being in the C+3 position.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
J Orman stated that from the inside barrier when his mount commenced well he was able to hold an on-pace position without having to apply pressure to his mount to do so.  Sent for sampling post-race.

After travelling a short distance became unbalanced when bumped on the hindquarters by VIVA FIRECRACKER which shifted out.  In the early stages of the Home Straight lay in when being shifted to the outside of LUCKY MCQUEEN.

Had its left hind plate adjusted in the holding stalls, was examined by the Veterinary Officer and passed suitable to race.  Jumped only fairly.  Shifted out after travelling a short distance, was bumped and became unbalanced.  In the Home Straight raced greenly when placed under pressure.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be a "roarer”.
No report.
No report.

H Bentley reported that his mount anticipated the start and as a result commenced only fairly.  He said approaching the first turn near the 1000 Metres LEAN MASTER commenced to race keenly and as a result got its head up when positioned close to the heels of FASHION LEGEND.  He added LEAN MASTER then continued to race keenly throughout the middle stages of the event and refused to settle.
Jumped only fairly.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Jumped awkwardly and then blundered shortly after the start.
In the middle stages raced keenly when being shifted behind LEAN MASTER to obtain cover.

Prior to declaring weighed-in the Stewards gave consideration as to whether SKY PHOENIX had been denied a fair start.  After taking evidence from Senior Starter Mr A Speechley it was established that as the start was effected SKY PHOENIX reared simultaneously, resulting in its rider K Teetan being dislodged and SKY PHOENIX completing the course riderless.  As the incident occurred simultaneously to the start being effected the horse was declared a runner.  Before being allowed to race again, SKY PHOENIX will be required to perform satisfactorily in consecutive barrier trials.  K Teetan was subsequently examined by the Chief Medical Officer and passed fit to fulfil his remaining riding engagements.

Shifted in on jumping, resulting in its rider A Badel having to correct his mount.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  From the 800 Metres raced very wide and without cover. A Badel was severely reprimanded in relation to using his whip in a manner where the hand holding the whip was above shoulder height on one occasion near the 200 Metres. Sent for sampling post-race.

Near the 1300 Metres was crowded.  In the Home Straight lay in and proved difficult to ride out.  Over the concluding stages K C Leung was unable to use his whip when positioned close to WINNING DATA.  Near the 50 Metres STAR ELEGANCE and WINNING DATA made slight contact due to both runners shifting ground.  K C Leung reported that his mount was slow to begin and as a consequence settled further back in the field than he had intended.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Near the 1300 Metres was crowded for room between THE AZURE and TO INFINITY which shifted in whilst being corrected by its rider J Orman.  Near the 50 Metres WINNING DATA and STAR ELEGANCE made slight contact due to both runners shifting ground.  Approaching the winning post raced tight between GOLDEN BRILLIANT and STAR ELEGANCE which shifted in when it continued to lay in.
Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Shifted out on jumping and made contact with STELLAR SWIFT.
Bumped at the start.  Near the 1300 Metres was crowded and made contact with the running rail.

From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Near the 1300 Metres shifted in and made contact with the running rail.  When being shifted out to avoid the running rail FORTUNE STAR made contact with STAR ELEGANCE.  Near the 300 Metres was briefly held up for clear running behind THE AZURE.

Bumped at the start.  H Bentley stated that his mount came under pressure soon after entering the Home Straight and finished the race off only fairly thereafter.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be a "roarer” 'which had previously been reported.
Near the 1300 Metres shifted in and made contact with WINNING DATA and then shifted out abruptly when being corrected by its rider.
L Hewitson could offer no explanation for his horse’s failure to run on in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Jumped awkwardly, shifted out abruptly and made contact with THE AZURE.  Raced keenly when positioned outside the lead in the early stages.
Near the 1300 Metres was hampered when taken wider by TO INFINITY which shifted out.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Shifted in shortly after the start and was bumped.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.

C L Chau stated that he was issued no specific instructions.  He said when his mount jumped well and the early stages of the race were run  outside of standard time he elected to take up a forward position. C L Chau was fined the sum of $20,000 in relation to using his whip in a manner where the hand holding the whip was above shoulder height on one occasion near the 300 Metres.
From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Shifted out shortly after the start and was bumped.
From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Lay in in the Home Straight.

Shortly after the start was badly crowded for room between CELTIC TIMES and WIN METHOD, both of which shifted ground.  Near the 900 Metres commenced to race keenly, shifted out and made contact with DILBAGH when being steadied to avoid CELTIC TIMES.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Lay out on the Home Turn and in the Home Straight.
Near the 900 Metres was bumped by ABSOLUTE AWAKENED.

Approaching the 1300 Metres shifted in and made contact with the running rail.  A Atzeni reported that his mount responded only fairly to his riding in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Sent for sampling post-race.

Shortly after the start was checked when badly crowded between KING MILES and PRESTIGE ALWAYS which shifted out and away from SUGAR SUGAR when that runner shifted out despite the efforts of its rider.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
No report.

C L Chau reported that after being bumped heavily shortly after the start, when a number of runners to his inside showed superior pace, he elected to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages to obtain cover. <12/3/2026 Additional Veterinary Report> The Veterinary Surgeon reported that KING MILES was lame in its right front leg on the morning after racing. Before being allowed to race again, KING MILES will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Shortly after the start made contact with VULCANUS due to both runners shifting ground.  Z Purton stated that his mount finished the race off only fairly in the Home Straight and, in his opinion, was reluctant to race in amongst other horses.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, BIENVENUE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  Sent for sampling post-race.

B Avdulla stated that his mount found it difficult to make up ground in the Home Straight after settling further back in the field than he had intended.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Shifted out shortly after the start and made heavy contact with KING OF FIGHTERS.  Approaching the 1000 Metres raced keenly when being steadied to allow SIGHT HERMOSO to cross.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  After the race an endoscopic examination was conducted on IGOT at the request of Trainer C H Yip.  The Veterinary Surgeon said this examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, IGOT will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Shortly after the start made contact with BIENVENUE due to both runners shifting ground.  Approaching the 300 Metres was eased to avoid KING MILES which shifted out to improve.
Near the 350 Metres made contact with RIDING HIGH when that runner was shifted out to improve.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Shortly after the start became unbalanced when crowded between HAPPY PARK and SAME TO YOU which shifted in.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Shifted in shortly after the start and became unbalanced when bumped.  Trainer M Newnham confirmed that he had instructed L Hewitson to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages.
Bumped on jumping.  Shifted out near the 350 Metres and was bumped.

Jumped awkwardly and then shortly after the start made contact with VICTOR THE RAPID.  K Teetan stated that his mount did not travel well throughout the event and responded only fairly to his riding in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its left front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, HAPPY PARK will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
Jumped only fairly.
Jumped only fairly.  From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
M F Poon reported that his mount raced greenly during the event and near the 600 Metres was steadied when it shifted out across FORTUNE WARRIOR.

Leaving the 600 Metres was hampered when taken wider by STARRY SHOW which shifted out.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, UP WITH CHARM will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
No report.
Bumped on jumping.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
Bumped on jumping.  Over the final 100 Metres was bumped on a number of occasions by FORERUNNER which shifted in.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Approaching the 150 Metres shifted to the inside of NORTHERN FIRE BALL to continue into clear running and as a result made contact with TEAM TEAM FOLKS.  FORERUNNER then raced tight between NORTHERN FIRE BALL and TEAM TEAM FOLKS over the final 100 Metres and made contact with TEAM TEAM FOLKS on a number of occasions.  Sent for sampling post-race.
For a short distance near the 300 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running when improving into a tight run between ICONICAL and WINNING MONEY.
No report.
Jumped only fairly.
Over the concluding stages could not be ridden out to the finish when racing tight between NORTHERN FIRE BALL and GOLDEN EMPIRE.

Jumped only fairly and then was crowded shortly after the start and became unbalanced.  Z Purton stated that after being crowded shortly after the start his mount was obliged to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Jumped only fairly.

Jumped awkwardly, shifted out and made contact with TEAM TEAM FOLKS.  Near the 900 Metres, when racing keenly, was steadied to avoid GOLDEN EMPIRE which shifted out slightly.  L Hewitson could offer no explanation for the horse’s disappointing performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Shortly after the start was badly crowded between WINNING MONEY and FLASH STAR which shifted in despite the efforts of its rider.

Shifted in at the start and made contact with ALWAYS AHEAD.  R Kingscote reported that in this incident his left foot was displaced from his stirrup for a short distance.  Raced very wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Shortly after the start shifted out and made contact with WINNING MONEY.  PRESTIGE SUPERIOR then raced tight between WINNING MONEY and FORERUNNER which shifted out slightly.
Shortly after the start was bumped on the hindquarters.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped awkwardly.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Shortly after the start was bumped.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
No report.
Sent for sampling post-race.

Near the 50 Metres was steadied when crowded between MEOWTH which shifted in slightly and ACE CHAMPION (R Kingscote) which was shifted to the outside of METRO POWER.  R Kingscote was advised to exercise more care.

From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  C Y Ho reported that his mount was disadvantaged by settling back in the field from the outside barrier.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Jumped only fairly and then shortly after the start was crowded by WONDER KIT which shifted out.  Near the 1100 Metres made contact with WONDERSTAR due to both runners shifting ground.  Raced keenly in the early and middle stages and refused to settle.
From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.

D B McMonagle stated that the instructions were to go forward.  He said shortly after the start his mount became unbalanced when crowded for room and as a consequence settled further back than intended.  He added near the 1100 Metres his mount made contact with YOUNG ARROW due to both runners shifting ground and this resulted in WONDERSTAR then racing keenly throughout the early and middle stages and refusing to settle.  Trainer Y S Tsui confirmed the instructions were to go forward and lead.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Sent for sampling post-race.

Bumped on jumping.  Near the 350 Metres shifted out to improve and made contact with MISTER DAPPER. M F Poon was severely reprimanded in relation to using his whip in a manner where the hand holding the whip was above shoulder height on one occasion near the 250 Metres.
No report.

Shortly after the start made contact with JUMBO LEGEND.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.

Kicked a rail behind the barriers, was examined by the Veterinary Officer and passed suitable to race.  Near the 350 Metres made contact with KEEFY when KEEFY was shifted to the outside of HIGHLAND RAHY to improve.

C Y Ho reported that after making contact with FALLON making the turn after the 600 Metres his mount did not run on in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Jumped only fairly.

Bumped shortly after the start.  H Bowman stated that his mount made a respiratory noise during the event and did not respond to his riding when asked for an effort from the 500 Metres.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be a "roarer” which had previously been reported.

D B McMonagle stated that from the outside barrier he was obliged to shift his mount behind runners in the early stages.  He said with the early stages of the event being run outside of standard time, when the pace of the race increased from the 600 Metres, his mount found it difficult to make up ground from back in the field.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
